snippet.title: YARG Setlist: JW Francis, RinRin, and more
snippet.description:
Wave 2 is available now! 5 new songs featuring Halfway To Michigan, JW Francis, RinRin, Troubled Minds, and Vandalheart are available to add to your collection! Just download/update the setlist through the launcher and the songs will automatically be included in your library when you launch YARG.

Download the YARG Launcher here: https://github.com/YARC-Official/YARC-Launcher/releases

If you're a developer, artist, or band and are interested in contributing to YARG, feel free to join us on Discord, GitHub, or contact us via our email. We are 100% open source and always welcome anyone who wants to contribute!

Interested in getting your music added to the official YARG setlist or a DLC pack? Reach out to yargchartingteam@gmail.com and we'll get back to you as soon as possible!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Featured Songs:
"John, Take Me With You" by JW Francis https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8CAL8vXUCCs
"Time" by Vandalheart https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=69tVVr6yGcs
"Buds" by Troubled Minds https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S5KaZf2y9Dk
"In My Head" by Halfway to Michigan https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S6SNhZAQA-Y
"The Game" by RinRin https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oENBHwPJAOs
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Website: https://yarg.in/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/yarg
GitHub: https://github.com/YARC-Official/YARG
